title: ALLWAYS · ARGON
lines: Allways · argon is everything Bolas has made under that name: 97 films, each a tower built of its own frames.
97 of them are cuts that kept a list of where every shot came from: 562 shots from 283 archive films.
Each of those cuts has a street. Its sources stand along it, and its own tower is dark until the jellies have carried each shot across.
